in_marathi.name: Vyanraaj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of the sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vyanraaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vyanraaj is a name of Indra, the king of gods in Hindu mythology. He is the god of rain, thunderbolts, and the sky. He is also the king of heaven, and the leader of the gods of the universe.

vedic_reference.note: The name Vyanraaj is derived from the Sanskrit language. The name can be broken down into two parts: 'Vyana' which means 'circulation of prana or life force' and 'Raj' which means 'king' or 'ruler'. This name is not directly mentioned in any Vedic texts, but it does carry a strong connection to the principles of life and power.
